new_backend_search.coverage: Bounded known diagnostics only; not an all-history claim.

official_api_semantics.Meta.Tactic.Refl.lean:25-39: MVarId.refl checks the target is Eq, obtains its lhs/rhs, optionally runs Meta.isDefEq only when check is true, and assigns the ordinary Eq.refl alpha lhs term. The API comment explicitly describes false as omitting an elaborator check.
official_api_semantics.Elab.Tactic.BuiltinTactic.lean:309-311: The existing equality-reflexivity elaborator calls mvarId.refl with the default check=true.
official_api_semantics.Elab.Tactic.Rfl.lean:26-28: The existing builtin apply_rfl implementation uses liftMetaFinishingTactic on a callback returning MetaM Unit, providing the reused wrapper pattern.
official_api_semantics.not_kernel_acceptance: Assigning the Eq.refl term does not by itself prove the final target or create a successful compilation record. Any mismatch must be rejected by the ordinary declaration kernel/checker gates.

diagnostic_instrumentation.location: Inside the same liftMetaFinishingTactic callback, strictly after goal.refl (check := false) returns.
diagnostic_instrumentation.output: stderr via IO.getStderr, putStrLn and flush; no data file is written.
diagnostic_instrumentation.evidence_if_observed: The official API completed the Meta goal assignment before this marker.
not_implied: The entire theorem has been accepted by Lean.
The independent kernel checker has passed.
All later time is necessarily in one specific kernel routine.
The earlier timeouts were proven to originate in Meta.isDefEq.

hypothesis_and_boundaries.hypothesis: Avoid the optional Meta definitional-equality precheck and test the same original closed Eq using the normal declaration kernel. The kernel has a same-definition-head comparison optimization, and the ToExpr Char/List constructor forms match kernel literal expansion, but this is only a reason for one bounded diagnostic.
hypothesis_and_boundaries.accepted_scope_if_all_gates_pass: Only the same local original cell00 String.ofList chars00 = oldString00 equality.

budgets_and_gates_to_preserve.heap_boundary: Normal and audit use original -M11264. leanchecker keeps its original --verbose command with a 180-second wall bound; the service enforces the job memory boundary.
budgets_and_gates_to_preserve.replay_boundary: The independent checker reads the fresh bound object, not the original JSON. Audit checks all serialized/environment-owned names including private/generated declarations.
budgets_and_gates_to_preserve.standard_library_boundary: Only the fixed Lean toolchain is used; no Mathlib or other ImbalancedChen library path is added. Direct standard-library objects and compiler/checker binaries are frozen; a new full standard-library source census is not claimed.
